two-sample-t-statistic.def: The test statistic of a two-sample t test: $t = \frac{(\bar{x}_1 - \bar{x}_2) - 0}{\sqrt{\frac{s_1^2}{n_1} + \frac{s_2^2}{n_2}}}$, the observed difference in sample means measured in standard errors. Its p-value comes from a t distribution with technology df or the conservative df.
